stories.title: Alleged ringleader of Penn State cocaine trafficking ring now faces federal charges
stories.summary: A federal grand jury has charged 24-year-old Agostino Abbatiello with conspiracy to distribute cocaine and six counts of distribution of cocaine, authorities said.

stories.title: Beloved local radio personality Sue Barre of 98.5 KRZ passes away
stories.summary: Beloved 98.5 KRZ radio personality Sue Barre has passed away, according to a tribute shared by her husband and former co-host Rocky Rhodes.

stories.title: Frozen turkeys, bowling balls, and a good cause: Turkey Toss returns
stories.summary: The annual Turkey Toss returns to Valley Bowling Lanes, letting participants bowl frozen turkeys to raise money and food for the Montdale Food Pantry.

stories.title: Olyphant council settles lawsuit with ERCOR Triboro LLC over proposed data centers
stories.summary: A Lackawanna County borough settled a lawsuit with ERCOR Triboro LLC for $101 million.

stories.title: 24 Lackawanna County residents involved in the New Orleans riverboat crash make it back home
stories.summary: Newswatch16's Kevin Gruen was there as their bus arrived.

stories.title: Lackawanna County officials emphasize road safety as holiday travel season approaches
stories.summary: Health care leaders, along with law enforcement officials, are urging drivers to stay safe this holiday season.

stories.title: Baaahd Girls in Schuylkill County weaving shawls to help raise funds for Cystic Fibrosis and Down syndrome causes
stories.summary: The Baaahd Girls are donating a portion of the money they raise during shawl-making competitions to not one, but two different organizations.

stories.title: Symposium in Scranton trains first responders, community members to support those with dementia
stories.summary: The goal of the symposium is to train community members and first responders in supportive strategies when encountering those living with dementia.

stories.title: Repairs have been made following water main break in Scranton
stories.summary: Scranton City Hall was closed for the day due to the water main break.

stories.title: Blue Mountain Resort starts snowmaking
stories.summary: Some early cold weather gave one ski resort in our area an opportunity to fire up the snow guns for the first time this season.

stories.title: Central Susquehanna Opportunities holds emergency food distribution for victims of card skimming scam in Sunbury
stories.summary: As Sunbury police continue to investigate the skimming scam, a nonprofit helped those impacted get some relief.

stories.title: Sunbury police and local organizations unite for 'Fill a Cruiser' food drive to help skimming scam victims
stories.summary: The community is coming together to help after 70 people were victims of a card skimming scam in Sunbury.
